^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

DellOemSoftwareInventory.description: This property shall represent the OEM properties for a SoftwareInventory resource.
DellOemSoftwareInventory.longDescription: This complex type provides OEM extensions for the DMTF SoftwareInventory resource, including plugin inventory properties and Dell-specific extensions.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

AppliesToPCIeIDs.description: Array of PCIe IDs for all physical devices consolidated into this FirmwareInventory URI. Format: VendorID:DeviceID:SubVendorID:SubDeviceID in hex.
AppliesToPCIeIDs.longDescription: Array of PCIe IDs for all physical devices that map to this consolidated FirmwareInventory URI. Each element is formatted as VendorID:DeviceID:SubVendorID:SubDeviceID in hexadecimal (zero-padded to 4 digits, uppercase, no 0x prefix). Absent for non-PCIe devices such as BIOS, iDRAC, TPM, and PSU.

ComponentID.longDescription: The component identifier from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails.Device@ComponentID.

ComponentName.longDescription: The component display name from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails.Device.Component@name.

ComponentNames.description: Array of all component names for multi-component DUPs.
ComponentNames.longDescription: Array of all component display names from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails.Device.Component@name elements. For multi-component DUPs, contains all components. For single-component DUPs, contains one element matching ComponentName.

ComponentVersions.description: Array of all component versions for multi-component DUPs.
ComponentVersions.longDescription: Array of all component versions from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails.Device.Component@version elements. Parallel array to ComponentNames - each version corresponds to the component at the same index.

Criticality.description: The criticality level: Recommended, Critical, or Optional.
Criticality.longDescription: The criticality level from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails@Criticality (server-side enum conversion: 1=Recommended, 2=Critical, 3=Optional).

CurrentVersion.longDescription: The currently installed firmware version from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails.Device.Component@version.

FileName.longDescription: The DUP package file name as extracted from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails@name.

HostResetRequiredOnUpdate.description: Indicates whether a host reset is required after the update.
HostResetRequiredOnUpdate.longDescription: This property shall indicate whether a host reset is required after the firmware update is applied.

PackageValidationStatus.description: The LC validator status: Starting, Success, or Failure.
PackageValidationStatus.longDescription: The LC validator status from the redownloader state machine. Starting = upload/validation in progress. Success = validated and ready for installation. Failure = validation failed.

PackageVersion.longDescription: The DUP package version (also serves as available version for GUI display) from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails@packageVersion.

PluginEnabled.description: The state of the plugin true when enabled, false when disabled.
PluginEnabled.longDescription: The state of the plugin true when enabled, false when disabled.

PluginResourceCPUTime.description: The cumulative CPU utilization of the process.
PluginResourceCPUTime.longDescription: The cumulative CPU utilization of the process.

PluginResourceElapsedRuntime.description: The amount of wall clock time the process has been running.
PluginResourceElapsedRuntime.longDescription: The amount of wall clock time the process has been running.

PluginSizeKB.description: Plugin File System size reported in terms of KB.
PluginSizeKB.longDescription: This property shall contain File System size reported in terms of KB.

PluginStatus.description: The current status of the plugin.
PluginStatus.longDescription: The current status of the plugin.

PrerequisiteMessages.longDescription: Array of prerequisite message details from lc_validator_output.xml PrerequisiteInfo.Messages.*.

RebootType.description: The reboot type required: NONE, IDRAC, HOST, or CHASSIS.
RebootType.longDescription: The reboot type required from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails@RebootType.

TargetFQDD.longDescription: The target device FQDD from lc_validator_output.xml Files.FileDetails.Device@target.

UnmetHardRequisites.longDescription: Count of unmet hard prerequisites from lc_validator_output.xml PrerequisiteInfo@iUnmetHardRequisites.

UnmetSoftRequisites.longDescription: Count of unmet soft prerequisites from lc_validator_output.xml PrerequisiteInfo@iUnmetSoftRequisites.

ValidationMessage.description: Error message when validation fails. Only present when PackageValidationStatus = Failure.
ValidationMessage.longDescription: Error message when validation fails (e.g., RED034, RED098, RED106, SYS017 text). Not present when PackageValidationStatus = Success.

PrerequisiteMessage.description: A prerequisite message with details about unmet requirements.
PrerequisiteMessage.longDescription: A prerequisite message with details about unmet requirements including message ID, text, unmet type, and severity.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

UnmetType.description: The unmet type: Hard or Soft.

Restart.description: The Restart operation shall restart plugin instance present in SoftwareInventory.
Restart.longDescription: The Restart operation shall restart plugin instance present in SoftwareInventory.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

Uninstall.description: The Uninstall operation shall remove plugin instance present in SoftwareInventory.
Uninstall.longDescription: The Uninstall operation shall remove plugin instance present in SoftwareInventory.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.
